postal_system.postcode_rule: Correios guidance and the UPU August 2026 length table support a four-digit postcode. A current assignment requires a permitted, successful and release-pinned operator or licensed assignment observation; syntax, a locality example or the dated 2014 coding hierarchy is insufficient.
postal_system.identifier_split_rule: The Correios contact page publishes NNNN-NNN branch values labelled Codigo Postal, while the CIP portal describes a numeric user or company postal-domicile identifier associated with a georeference. Until a current operator schema explicitly maps these objects, four-digit postcode, published extended contact identifier and private CIP remain separate and no digits are appended, removed or inferred.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No rights-cleared nationwide official postcode polygon release is bundled or identified. Island, municipality, parish, zone, locality and neighbourhood layers, CIP georeferences, branch points, cadastre, buffers, Voronoi cells and learned surfaces are not official postcode polygons; permitted generated surfaces remain derived non-canonical review geometry.
postal_system.address_rule: Correios and UPU formatting pages establish address fields and examples, not reusable address rows. Store island, municipality, parish, locality or zone, street, house number, four-digit postcode, extended operator identifier, CIP, premises, unit and P.O. Box as typed fields with separate provenance.
postal_system.building_rule: An exact building or parcel may be returned only from an exact rights-cleared artifact with a stable explicit CIP-to-address-to-building or cadastral relation. Postcode, extended identifier syntax, CIP syntax, address text, coordinate containment, overlap, nearest feature and model score are candidates only.
postal_system.licence_rule: Correios pages carry an all-rights-reserved notice, UPU database rights are separate from publication access, and every IDE-CV, ArcGIS and cadastral artifact needs exact owner, licence, access class, version and digests. OSM stays in a separate attributed ODbL partition.
postal_system.privacy_rule: CIP identifies a person or company postal domicile and is linked to a georeference. CIP, account, precise address, premises, parcel, building, resident, owner, title, delivery and query-log data require purpose limitation, authority or consent, minimisation, retention, access control and publication review.
postal_system.hosting_rule: Cloudflare and Hugging Face may host only rights-cleared immutable artifacts pinned to releases or Hub commits with verified digests. Private CIP, account, household, parcel, title, owner, query-log, credential and access-controlled material remains gated or external.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Versioned crosswalks may relate permitted postcode, CIP, address, administrative, building and derived review objects to AGID cells without relabelling an AGID cell as canonical Cabo Verde postal or administrative geometry.

stages.definition: Legacy Cabo Verde address-format metadata and synthetic Postal Context fixture inventory.

Digest-bound Correios, UPU and INGT evidence for the current four-digit postcode system, operator NNNN-NNN contact identifiers, private CIP, rights and administrative-geometry boundaries, with synthetic-only runtime contracts.

M2 requires a complete finite current denominator of every Correios Cabo Verde four-digit postcode assignment, alias, locality or zone, validity interval, correction, exception and explicit area/non-area object, fixed by retrieval time, operator edition, stable identity, schema, coverage, bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. The four-digit postcode, operator-published NNNN-NNN contact identifier and authenticated CIP must remain separate unless an operator schema explicitly relates them. Every drawable postcode must reconcile to fixed real Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry with postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exceptions. Island, municipality, parish, zone, locality, neighbourhood, branch, address, CIP georeference, Point, route, building, parcel, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster or AGID cell and model output are prohibited postal-area proxies. An approved immutable artifact must drive the real CV API/app through normalization, loading, no-match, multiple, failure, invalid geometry, map fit, translucent fill, clear outline, metadata, clear and re-search.

agid_integration.current_scope: Source-qualified Cabo Verde address and administrative context plus independent CV AGID spatial identity only; no production CV Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A complete current operator assignment denominator, compatible rights and exact postal Polygon/MultiPolygon artifacts must pass the CV quality gate and real API/app verification.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Do not manufacture a CV postal polygon from INGT administration, contact branches, CIP georeferences, OSM, learned models or AGID cells. Detailed buildings require an independent rights-cleared identity and explicit relation.
